headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 1,350.8 Million Dollars From 976.6 Million As Bitstamp Turns To A 17.0 Million Dollar Inflow From A 301.4 Million Dollar Outflow
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges rose to 1,350.8 million dollars from 976.6 million, equal to 0.4969 percent of the 271.8 billion dollars held on those venues, compared with 0.3604 percent on the prior reading. Bitstamp turned to a 17.0 million dollar inflow from a 301.4 million dollar outflow, so dollars are now arriving on that venue instead of leaving it, while Binance intake eased to 852.3 million dollars from 862.7 million. Bitfinex took in 229.6 million dollars, Deribit took in 178.5 million dollars, and BingX sent out 19.6 million dollars; a positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token.
author: jordan
